fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: A trained thrust into the gap between plates that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Lunge
fusions.desc: A drilled lunge at the weapon arm that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 4 tiles, and leaves the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Drilled Guard
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Worn Like Skin
fusions.desc: Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.
